column7: A machine token of a soft-deleted project kept authenticating (cold and warm auth cache), because deleteProjectCascade never touched machine_identities. Decision (option a): the project soft-delete now suspends, in the cascade transaction, every active machine identity whose only live roles are in that project, records the cascade marker (project id + deleted_at) and writes one machine_identity.suspended audit event per identity (actor = deleting admin, reason = project soft-delete); RestoreProject re-activates exactly the identities that still carry the marker and that nothing has written since. Postgres leg runs when KEYORIX_TEST_PG_DSN is set; the route-wide proof is server/http TestEveryRouteRefusesADeadCredential (machine_token_project_deleted, cold + warm).
